current_step.description: The step the next signature signs, from 1; 0 once every step has its quorum.

decided_at.description: When it was approved, rejected or voided.

diff.description: What it changes, before and after (FR-APR-02).

envelope.description: The approval envelope exactly as signed: RFC 8785 canonical JSON (FR-APR-10).

envelope_hash.description: The envelope's SHA-256, in hex: send it to approve or reject exactly what you were shown.

expires_at.description: When it expires unless decided: 7 days after it was asked for (FR-APR-05).

invitation_code.description: Only in the 202 answer to an invitation: its one-time code, shown once, which works once the invitation is approved.

object_key.description: Which one: the setting's key, the membership's ID, the invitation's code hash, the object type whose approval policy changes, the statutory pack version, or organisation for the team mode.

policy.description: The approval policy's version it keeps (G4-057).

requested_by.description: The user who asked for it.

signatures.description: Its signed approvals and rejections, in order (FR-APR-03).

status.description: pending waits for approval; approved executed it; void means its record, a dependency, its approval policy or the team mode changed (FR-APR-05), an earlier approver lost their right, or its requester withdrew it, as status_reason says; expired after 7 days.

status_reason.description: Why it was rejected or voided.
examples: the setting changed after the request

steps.description: The steps of that policy, in order, with the approvals each has (FR-APR-01, rev 0.40).

summary.description: What it does, in a sentence.
examples: Change Tolerance for base-currency differences from 1.00 to 5.00 from 2026-10-20

you_may_approve.description: true when you may approve or reject it now: it is pending, you did not ask for it and you hold the approval right.
